call.description: An operation and its arguments. The operationId is one the contracts declare, as overlays leave them; the arguments are checked against that operation's parameters and request schema. A stored call leaves out the `Idempotency-Key` header even where its operation requires one: a key guards one request, so whatever makes the call supplies it.

parameters.description: The operation's path, query, header and cookie parameters, as an Arazzo step or an OpenAPI operation lists them.

name.description: The parameter's name, as the operation declares it.

requestBody.description: The request body a call sends, as an Arazzo step's requestBody: the body itself in `payload`, and the media type in `contentType` when the operation accepts more than one.

contentType.description: One of the media types the operation's requestBody lists. Defaults to application/json.

payload.description: The request body, in the operation's request schema.
